notes: Auto RePost ka downloader ab aur samajhdar ho gaya hai: agar YouTube kisi video ko 403 (Forbidden) keh kar rok de, to app khud bari bari teen mukhtalif client chains try karti hai — pehle android_vr,android,tv, phir mweb, phir android_vr — taake video kisi na kisi darwaze se download ho jaye. Ye sab EK hi koshish ke andar hota hai, aap ko kuch nahi karna. Watch ke card par ab ye bhi dikhega ke video kis chain se post hui (masalan [chain: mweb]), aur agar teeno chains rok di jayein to card par un teeno ke naam likhe nazar ayenge. Apni rukki hui Kimmel video ke liye watch par 'Abhi post karo' try karein.
